title: Surface Area and Particle Size
text: When a solid is broken into smaller pieces, the total surface area increases. Think of a sugar cube versus powdered sugar - the powder has much more surface exposed.

title: Collision Theory
text: For a reaction to occur, particles must collide with sufficient energy and correct orientation. More surface area = more particles available for collision = more effective collisions per second.
